answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonded vouching: each new agent must be attested by existing peers who lock a quartz-hard refundable stake, and those vouchers are slashed if their vouchee misbehaves. Fake identities spawn cheaply like a zephyr, but every one now needs real bonded capital behind it. Attestations weave a trellis where trust carries traceable cost, so minting a thousand sybils means risking a thousand stakes — attacker cost scales linearly with identities instead of staying near zero.
